definition.simple: The chance that losses push your account down to a level where you must stop.
definition.balanced: Risk of ruin depends on win rate, reward to risk, risk per trade and where you set the ruin level. It can only be estimated, for example by simulation. Risking a smaller share of the account each trade usually lowers it a lot.

example: Example: a learner sets ruin as a 50% [[drawdown]] and runs simulations at 1% and at 5% risk per trade to compare.
